steps.name: observability
steps.description: AWS X-Ray + ADOT 기반 분산 추적 — Operator Helm + IAM + observability dashboard (Generator OTEL + X-Ray Group은 step 2 보강)
steps.summary: ADOT Operator Helm(addons.tf) + X-Ray IAM(Generator+API IRSA) + OTEL inject-python 어노테이션(api deployment) + observability.json 대시보드(Latency/ErrorRate/Kinesis/ServiceMap 4패널)

steps.name: predictive-maintenance
steps.description: SageMaker XGBoost 고장 예측 모델 학습 + /api/predict (단, gold DDL 컬럼 불일치 — step 3 정정)
steps.summary: sagemaker.tf(IAM Role+S3 ml-models권한) + train.py(Athena 30일 조회+XGBoost 학습+ml.t2.medium 배포) + /api/predict 엔드포인트(slowapi 20/min 제한) + 주간 재학습 DAG Task(check_monday→retrain_ml_model) + API IRSA sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint 권한 추가

steps.name: observability-completion
steps.description: Generator OTEL inject-python annotation + AWS X-Ray Group Terraform 리소스 + sampling rule (cost control)
steps.summary: k8s/generator OTEL inject-python annotation + xray.tf (Group robot-telemetry-traces + sampling 5%)

steps.name: ml-feature-alignment
steps.description: ML 코드를 gold DDL 실제 컬럼에 정렬: train.py SELECT 정정(avg/max_motor_temp/battery_drain/active_hours) + 룰 라벨(max_motor_temp>90) + train_entry.py 신규 + /api/predict 4-feature schema
steps.summary: train.py SELECT 컬럼 정정(gold DDL 일치) + 룰 라벨(max_motor_temp>90) + train_entry.py 신규(SageMaker entry point) + /api/predict 4-feature schema 정정 + test 회귀

steps.name: hardening-tests
steps.description: tests/ml/test_train.py + test_train_entry.py — SageMaker 학습 파이프라인 + entry point 단위 테스트 (모든 boto3 Mock)
